name: timegrapher
description: Test a mechanical watch at home from the sound of its ticking: rate, amplitude and beat error, with charts.
long_description: The open-source timegrapher in your chat app. It reads recordings of a watch, records each position from the microphone when you allow it, and shows the readings as charts in the conversation. It brings the watchmaker skill, so the chat app can guide a multi-position test and say plainly whether the watch needs a service. Nothing is uploaded, and your sound settings are never changed.
